N1-Sol-1.note: Identifies bubbling to .bar and clearing on the fresh mousedown before the click emits selection.

N1-Sol-2.note: Identifies the fresh mousedown as the clearing step, then #activate as the selection emitter.

N1-Sol-3.note: Places clearing on mousedown at the bar before the item click handler emits selection.

N2-Sol-1.note: Identifies preservation on the new mousedown and the early return before selection after consuming suppression.

N2-Sol-2.note: Distinguishes the separate mousedown, which preserves suppression, from the click consumed before selection.

N2-Sol-3.note: Identifies preservation on the new mousedown and mouseup, then consumption and return before selection dispatch.
